initial_conditions: no requirement to begin from sleep

planned_phases.action: connect charging interface and record recognition and locking when independently observed
perform authorization and request charging start; actual timing may vary
check whether charging actually established using independent vehicle and EVSE evidence
observe EVSE and Pack voltage current power capability state and thermal context
observe a conditional short stable interval if naturally available
request one normal stop if charging has not already ended
confirm output stopped and lock released before disconnecting
retain an optional post-disconnect observation tail

procedure_constraints: planned action order may change to follow the EVSE operating procedure
charging may start or stop earlier than the nominal planned time
a planned steady interval exists only if the observed process naturally becomes stable
Pack current alone does not confirm that EVSE output stopped
planned actions do not establish observed event times
